title: Moving averages
goal: See how SMA and EMA smooth out a wiggly price line.

objectives.text: Say what a moving average does.
Say how the SMA is made.
Say how the EMA is different.
Know that a moving average is late.

slides.text: An indicator is a line or bars added to a chart. It is made from the price numbers. It cannot see what is next.
slides.title: What is an indicator?

slides.text: An average is one fair number for a group. Add the group up. Then divide by the count.
slides.title: What is an average?

slides.text: A moving average is the average price of the last few candles. It slides on as new candles come. It smooths out the wiggles.
slides.title: The moving average

demo.caption: Real Apple prices. The line is the 20 day average.

slides.text: The SMA adds up the last 20 closes and divides by 20. Each candle counts the same.
slides.title: The SMA

slides.text: The EMA counts new candles more than old ones. So it turns sooner than the SMA. It uses 20 candles too.
slides.title: The EMA

demo.caption: Real Apple prices. Solid is the SMA. Dashed is the EMA.

slides.text: A moving average tries to show which way the price has leaned. Price over the line means it rose. Under it means it fell.
slides.title: What it tries to tell you

slides.text: A moving average is built from old prices, so it is late. In a flat market it gives many false hints. Do not trust it alone.
slides.title: Do not trust it alone

options.text: A line or bars made from prices

questions.explanation: An indicator is added to a chart. It is made from the price numbers.

questions.prompt: An indicator can see the future.
questions.explanation: No. An indicator only uses prices from the past.

questions.prompt: What does a moving average do?
questions.explanation: It averages a few candles. The wiggles get small.

questions.prompt: A 20 SMA adds up how many closes?
questions.explanation: A 20 SMA adds the last 20 closes and divides by 20.

questions.prompt: The EMA turns sooner than the SMA.
questions.explanation: Yes. The EMA counts new candles more, so it reacts fast.

questions.prompt: Match each word to its meaning.

pairs.definition: The average of the last few candles
A line or bars made from prices

questions.explanation: The SMA and the EMA are both moving averages. They count candles in two ways.

questions.prompt: A moving average is late, because it uses old prices.
questions.explanation: Yes. It shows the past. So it turns late.

questions.prompt: Price is over its moving average. What is true?
questions.explanation: It shows the past. It makes no promise.
